title: Odd-dimensional majority as a normalized threshold
statement: For every natural number $m$ and every sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^{2m+1}$, the majority of the coordinates of $x$ equals the threshold sign of their sum divided by $\sqrt{2m+1}$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $2m+1$
